description: Change one of your Besidka chats: rename it, pin or unpin it, exclude it from or include it in memory, or move it into a project or out of one. Pass at least one of title, pinned, memoryExcluded and projectId. Each field sets the value you give. Including a chat in memory again covers messages written from now on, not earlier ones. If a call fails partway, the fields before the failing one are already applied, in the order title, pinned, memoryExcluded, projectId. Returns the chat as it is now. Requires signing in (chats:write).

memoryExcluded.description: true keeps the chat out of memory and removes what memory learned from it, false allows it again

pinned.description: true pins the chat, false unpins it

projectId.description: Project id from list_projects to move the chat into, or null to take it out of its project

name: update_chat
title: Update a chat
